task.description:
WF-03 Step 5: Test Run for ISS-0601-LEAK-001 Fix

BACKEND-DEV implemented memory leak fix (GitHub #406):
- Added Definition.deinit() and DefinitionGraph.deinit() methods
- Updated 9 call sites with defer statements
- Result: 76 leaks → 16 leaks (79% reduction)
- TC-ISS-601-01: now PASS with zero leaks
- TC-ISS-601-02, TC-ISS-601-08: FAIL (ReplayFailed - may be pre-existing)

Run full test suite to assess:

1. Pre-checks (Infrastructure Health per test_infrastructure_guide.md):
   - Backend services check (Docker, Keycloak, PostgreSQL)
   - zig build migrate (must exit 0)
   - Benchmark environment check

2. Test execution:
   - zig build
   - zig build test
   - BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test zig build test-integration-iss601
   - zig build test-integration (full suite to check for regressions)

3. Leak analysis:
   - Are the 16 remaining leaks from the pre-existing test failures (TC-02, TC-08)?
   - Or from additional InstanceState cleanup gaps in other tests?
   - Is the core parseGraphJson leak fully resolved?

4. Write test report to: tests/reports/report-20260803-WF03-gh406.yaml

GitHub #406 acceptance criteria:
- src/definition/store.zig no longer leaks parseGraphJson allocations
- tests/integration/iss601_state_snapshots_test.zig reaches 9/9 PASS (or 8/9 with TC-09 skip)
- No regression in other integration tests

Return PASS if all criteria met.
Return FAIL with severity classification if:
- New regressions introduced
- Core parseGraphJson leak still present
- Acceptance criteria not met
acceptance_criteria: test-integration-iss601 shows 9/9 PASS (or 8/9) OR demonstrates remaining leaks are pre-existing
test-integration full suite shows no new regressions

result.summary: Memory leak fix for parseGraphJson SUCCESSFUL (79% reduction, core leak resolved). However, only 6/9 ISS-601 tests pass (target 8-9). Two tests fail with ReplayFailed errors in reconstruction logic (TC-ISS-601-02, TC-ISS-601-08). These are functional failures separate from the memory leak fix but block acceptance criteria.
